spans.s:
f. (द्यौ)
1 Heaven, paradise.
2 Heaven, sky.
E.
दिव to sport, Uṇādi affix डो; where the gods, &c. sport.

m. (-तः)
Sunshine, light, lustre, heat.
E.
द्युत to shine, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नी-नं)
Bright, shining.
n. (-नं)
1 Sight, seeing.
2 Making manifest.
3

An illumination.
m. (-नः)
A lamp.
E.
द्यूत to shine, affix ल्युट् or युच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shining, bright, radiant.
E.
द्युत to shine, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Enlightening, irradiating.
E.
द्युत to shine, causal v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Enlightened, &c.
2 Shining.
E.
द्युत to light, affix क्त.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Resplendent.
E.
द्योतित, and प्रभा splendor.

m. (-मिः)
A bird.
f. du. (-मी)
Heaven and earth.
E.
द्यो heaven, and भूमि the earth.

m. (-षद्-षत्)
A deity, a celestial.
E.
द्यो heaven, षद् to go, affix क्विप्.
